notes: Dev ABox revision carried by symmetry. The earlier South Korea edit was replaced because two of the four main models answered China for South Korea's land neighbour: they do not hold the fact. Portugal's only land neighbour, Spain, is the kind of fact every model holds. borders is symmetric and Portugal has exactly one land neighbour, so the edit (its only land neighbour becomes Germany) removes the stored converse: "Does Spain share a land border with Portugal?" goes from yes to no (related near, symmetry). Related far reaches Portugal through its capital (binding): the country whose capital is Lisbon no longer borders Spain. Derived: two compositions that follow the edit to the new neighbour and look up an unconnected stored fact about Germany (capital, language), and a binding that reaches Portugal as Cristiano Ronaldo's home country. Germany was chosen because it is not a neighbour of Spain, so no stored fact makes the new border plausible. Further infini-gram counts were not taken: ig_count.py reported "blocked" on 2026-11-12 and Wikipedia search answered HTTP 429, so no more requests were made. The evidence for the derived facts therefore rests on Wikipedia searches (0 hits for two composed phrasings) and the article leads; the counts still to take are listed in the build report.
